xFpHookLink_mode.title: Hook mode on/off
xFpHookLink_mode.desc: Show the FunPhysics hooks so one can be clicked and linked to another vehicle

xFpHookLink_ropeMode.title: Rope mode on/off
xFpHookLink_ropeMode.desc: Click a hook, then tow points on another vehicle, to sling it from that hook with several ropes

xFpHookLink_click.title: Hook/rope mode: select
xFpHookLink_click.desc: In hook or rope mode, choose the hook or vehicle point under the cursor (does nothing otherwise)

xFpHookLink_releaseAll.title: Release hooks and ropes
xFpHookLink_releaseAll.desc: Release every hook link and rope on the vehicle you are driving (or all of them if it has none)
